Noida’s Real Estate Bubble: Who Pays When Developers Fail?
Noida’s real estate boom left thousands of homebuyers stuck with unfinished homes after developers took on too many projects and eventually went bankrupt. The story explores how Noida’s land-allotment system fuelled the bubble, why insolvency creates a conflict between homebuyers and creditors, and what the Supreme Court’s Granite Gate ruling means for homebuyer protection.
